exact_statement: For every integer m>=2 take canonical G_m and its actual z terminals b_m,c_m of A067-POSTCORE-BENT-FLAG-SAME-CHILD-BANK@1. On the edited z=- branch successively query one member of any intact quadratic pair, stop each outcome-1 clean exit with its full inherited reference, and continue on outcome0 for any h<=m. Let Q_t be ONLY the original c_m spectrum marginalized over these t physical coordinates, P_t the actual edited-child spectrum, A=2^-m, delta=2^(-(2m+1)),delta_t=2^t delta. P_t/Q_t is 2^t except on the cell with w unoccupied and at least one exposed partner occupied, where it is 2^t A^2/(1+A^2). Hence every next intact-pair Fourier bit has equal P_t and Q_t conditionals. Its signed CE-drop-minus-2Inf debit is <=-4delta_t; with original G reaches the cumulative debit E_Q<=-2h delta. Retaining both full children, unchanged b_m, original bank S, old z debit D, and every signed terminal CE/KL bill gives S_Q(h)-(D+E_Q)=S-D=r>delta/4. Actual entropy ledger adds the SAME full weighted terminal KL to both bank and debit. The conditional equality/nonpositive-debit conclusions are not claimed for exposed-partner or w queries, prescribed reference resets, arbitrary phases or arbitrary cores; negative inherited terminal banks are not C2 leaf certificates.
